title: DARPA smart dust field tests

tellings.quote: By 2001, DARPA was demonstrating smart dust in field tests.

plain: By 2001, DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced research, was field testing "smart dust," tiny sensors so small they can float like dust. Jesse Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in a 2026 episode about a UFO book the Pentagon tried to censor. He raises it as an example of how far secret military technology had already come.
